data.body: Closed CERTIFIED (no force). Plan-review close gate: after children landed, the story attestation went stale (stale-code + stale-pin-drift on children 67d4/dd65). Re-ran review-plan on the story; it surfaced two genuine plan-vs-code gaps against the landed reconciler: (E2) commit_unknown disposition was stated only as a fuse-counter exclusion — added its actual coordinator disposition (ticket-scoped; projected to the 'deferred' AC6 bucket per _BUCKET_BY_DISPOSITION; replay-forbidden per replay_safety_for -> ReplaySafety.forbidden; re-observed next reconcile pass); (G6) the 'Eligible exhausted outcome' bullet claimed eligibility keys off provenance-not-disposition and excluded a first-attempt retryable_deferred, contradicting is_fuse_eligible which keys purely on FUSE_ELIGIBLE_DISPOSITIONS — rewrote it to match the code (both budget-cap dispositions eligible; non-capped transients are absorbed as retries and never surface as terminal dispositions, so disposition-membership IS budget-provenance; a first-attempt cumulative-sleep-cap defer is itself a budget-cap outcome and is eligible). Fresh review-plan -> PASS, signed, closed. Unblocked S4 (59b0).
